entities.summary: Antonio Turiel Martínez is a scientist and teacher of Physics and Math. He has a doctorate in Theoretical Physics from the Universidad Autónoma de Madrid. He works with the Instituto de Ciencias del Mar at CSIC, located in Barcelona.
